instruction.text: Find the word that is spelt incorrectly.

hint.text:
When the root word ends in 'y' it is changed to 'ic' before adding the suffix '-ation'.
specify + ation = specification

If the root word ends in 'e' then it is dropped before adding the suffix '-ation'.
declare + ation = declaration

If the root word ends in 'ate' then it is dropped before adding the suffix '-ation'.
locate + ation = location
